findings.passage: Supervisor Nathan Magsig said he believed the aim was to “reduce Second Amendment rights.”
findings.note: Quoted in a Fresnoland news story about the county board voting to oppose the governor-backed 'Right to Safety' constitutional amendment effort; Magsig describes its purpose as reducing Second Amendment rights. Paraphrase of his remark by the outlet with a short direct quote.
subjects: opposing a state gun-safety constitutional amendment

findings.passage: The way I look at it, fortunately that individual is recovering from their injuries but if any one of those deputy DA's were armed, it's possibly they could've prevented that attack
findings.note: Quoted by ABC30 on a county ordinance letting some District Attorney office staff carry concealed firearms; Magsig says an armed deputy might have stopped a recent attack.

findings.passage: I think that these ordinances are absolutely necessary to protect individuals who work here downtown, not only for themselves, but also to protect other members of the public
findings.note: Quoted by ABC30 defending the concealed-carry ordinance for county staff as necessary for safety.
